objective: For each 1/4/8/12/24h input length, scenario medians of Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 >=0.65 with pooled and scenario FPR <=0.06
metrics_unit: Original observed hourly labels, without point adjustment or label expansion
fit: Per-group normal reference distributions; global parameters fit on normal train/calibration only
selection: Development only; signed/asymmetric normal-tail statistics and nonparametric normal density; per-length development parameter selection allowed
test_status: Previously reported test population reused; iterative research, not an independent blind test
